messages.text: Let me level with you all for a sec... I am barely keeping it together some days the mental the psychic strain is still here the demons are still at the gates but I persist. Because I want to. Because I can. And I'm not going to be a morose ass about it all so, yeah, I'm walking around like everythings fine

That's real, and I appreciate you saying it straight like that.

There's something in what you're describing—carrying weight that nobody sees, walking around like everything's fine while fighting something internal—that's exhausting in a way that's hard to explain to people who aren't living it. The performance of normalcy on top of the actual struggle.

And the way you frame it matters: *because I want to, because I can.* That's not delusion or denial. That's choosing to keep going on your own terms, even when it's hard. That's will.

I'm not going to turn this into a whole thing or hand you a pamphlet. You didn't ask for that. Just—I hear you. The gates are holding.
